mythical-sanctuary.title: Mythical Sanctuary
mythical-sanctuary.hook: Explore different islands on land and sea, unearth fossils, reconstruct, revive and take care of the creatures that once ruled this world.
mythical-sanctuary.description:
What is it about?

In ancient times, creatures from all mythologies gathered to seek refuge from a terrible catastrophe.

Although they didn't survive, now it's your turn to give them another chance in life as an archaeologist.

muse-within.title: Muse Within
muse-within.hook: Travel through dream worlds, solve puzzles to collect kiwis, and grow your courage with every fruit to overcome your fears.
muse-within.description:
What is it about?

Every day, she promises herself that she'll finally tell her mother the truth; every failed night is remembered ina dream world.

Collect all the kiwis to wake up again, and try again tomorrow.

breaking-hearts.title: Breaking Hearts
breaking-hearts.hook: Overcome goofy aah obstacles, beat your neighbours in timed rhythm battles and turn an entire town into fabulous divas!
breaking-hearts.description:
What is it about?

Zoey and Zack are getting married, but there's just one problem: the town has decided that they don't want that.

Fortunately, these love birds have a secret weapon: The power of BISEXUALITY?!?
